Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The study consists of two proteomics parts: a basal cytosolic proteome analysis and a PCNA interactome analysis via co-immunoprecipitation (AP-MS). Both used a QExactive+ (DDA) and spectral counting for quantification. PTMs like phosphorylation and acetylation are mentioned in the PRIDE identifiedPTMStrings, but the primary goal was protein identification and abundance.

scope: PCNA was immunoprecipitated in the cytosol of neutrophils (either from HD or from COVID-19 patients) using a rabbit polyclonal anti-PCNA (Ab5).
For interactome analyses, PCNA was immunoprecipitated in the cytosol of two patients’ neutrophils using a rabbit polyclonal anti-PCNA (Ab5) using Miltenyi magnetic beads
subcellular_fraction: The neutrophil cytosolic fraction was obtained by sonication in a hypotonic buffer
Proteomic analyses were performed on neutrophil cytosols from healthy donors and patients with severe or critical COVID-19.
